title: Seed quantization profiles and iterative calibration harness for per-model defaults
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible pipeline that proposes a small set of "seed" quantization profiles (FP8 / INT8) per model in the catalog and an iterative calibration harness to validate accuracy and surface guardrails. The output should be a per-model recommended default, a set of fallback profiles, and metadata describing the validation confidence (delta vs FP32, confidence band, sample size). This ticket covers spec, initial implementation, and integration points with model onboarding and the catalog UI.
acceptance_criteria: A seed profile generator produces 2-4 candidate quantization profiles (FP8/INT8 mixed) for a given model artifact with deterministic provenance metadata
Calibration harness runs on labeled prompt suites and reports delta-accuracy vs FP32 with 95% confidence intervals
Per-model default recommendation appears in the model catalog as 'recommended_quant_profile' with an attached confidence band and fallback chain
A rollback/fallback policy is defined: if live latency/quality regression crosses thresholds the system will auto-switch to the next-safe profile
Automation includes a 'shadow validation' mode that can run the recommended profile on sampled live traffic and report drift alerts
notes_and_decisions: Decision 2026-02-18: use mixed FP8/INT8 presets rather than a single precision for initial rollout to maximize cost wins while containing accuracy risk
Decision 2026-02-23: require 1k+ measured prompt examples or equivalent bootstrap via stratified sampling per domain before a profile can be promoted to 'recommended'

Trade-off: longer calibration runs (more samples) reduce false positives but increase wall-clock validation time; we will operate with a configurable sample_size and default to 4k for high-risk models
Provenance: every profile will include the calibration dataset hash, seed-profile version, calibration-run-id, and runtime kernel configuration string
Guardrail thresholds: default delta-perplexity <= 3% and task-level accuracy drop <= 1.5% unless explicit product acceptance
test_plan: Unit tests for profile generator and serialization (profile -> JSON + provenance)
Integration test: run calibration harness against the 'squad-lite' prompt-suite and assert reported deltas are within expected ranges
Regression test: run golden-prompt-suite and ensure recommended profile doesn't exceed delta thresholds on repeated runs
Shadow validation: deploy recommended profile behind a shadow traffic switch for 72 hours at 1% sampling and run online drift detection job
